_about: F39 RANK TWISTS (GDD rank twists; v1 numbers from research/v1/PRD.md; F78: the rank each starts at is content/tuning/ladder.json beats twoColourPieces / cracksGrow / wildGoop): from twoColourPieces some pieces fall in two colours (two even, connected halves that lock as two clumps); from cracksGrow, when a new crack would form there is a grow.extendChance chance it grows an old crack by one cell instead, from one of its uncovered cells only (F83, Muzzy 2026-11-02: 'the same squares of cracks form, but the cracks growing does increase difficulty because you have to cover the whole crack'; a grown crack is ONE crack: sealed only when every cell is covered by its colour, then it counts its cell count toward the quota; it drains per cell); from wildGoop some pieces are wild goop (plugs any crack colour; a normal piece landing next to a wild clump turns the whole clump its colour). Read by the engine (src/engine/twists.ts) at the moment each number is used, on the rules clock — live in the Dev Kit. Seeded by the shift's random numbers, so ?seed plays repeat. Chances are 0..1.

_help.split.chance: The share of pieces that fall in two colours (0.25 = one in four). Corrupt and wild pieces never split.
_help.grow.extendChance: When a new crack would form, the chance it grows an existing crack by one cell instead (0.25 = about one in four). It grows only from a cell nothing covers; if no crack can grow, a new crack forms. Slow Cracks lowers it.
_help.grow.diagonals: true = a crack can grow into the 8 cells round it (v1); false = only up, down, left, right.
_help.wild.chance: The share of pieces that are wild goop (0.15 = about one in seven). Corrupt pieces are never wild; wild is never two-colour.
